Part 2&3 事件 EVENTS AI 补全经历

Describe an event you attended in which you didn't enjoy the music played

描述一个你参加过的、你不喜欢所放音乐的活动

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe an event you attended in which you didn't enjoy the music played

  • What it was (是什么活动)
  • Who you went with (你和谁一起去的)
  • Why you decided to go there (你为什么决定去)
  • And explain why you didn't enjoy it (并解释你为什么不喜欢它)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe an event you attended in which you didn't enjoy the music played

I'd like to describe an event I attended where I really didn't enjoy the music. It was a promotion event at a shopping mall, and it happened about half a year ago, on a weekend afternoon. I went there with my girlfriend. We had planned to spend the afternoon shopping and having a look around the mall, and when we arrived, we noticed that a big stage had been set up on the ground floor. A local store was holding a sales promotion, and they'd hired a singer to perform live to attract customers. The music itself was the main problem. The singer was clearly not very experienced, and he kept going off-key, especially on the high notes. On top of that, the speakers were turned up extremely loud, so the sound was harsh and uncomfortable to listen to. It was the kind of noise that made you want to cover your ears, and it echoed through the whole building. The reason I didn't enjoy it is that the combination of bad singing and excessive volume made the whole experience unpleasant. We had planned to browse the shops for a while, but after a few minutes we decided to go inside the stores instead, just to get away from the noise. Looking back, I remember the day mainly because of how bad the music was, which is a shame, because the mall itself is usually a nice place to visit.

讲的是半年前一个周末下午，在商场参加的一场促销活动，音乐很难听。和谁去：和女朋友，本来计划下午逛街，到商场发现一楼搭了大舞台，一家店搞促销，请了个歌手现场唱歌招揽顾客。音乐问题：歌手明显没什么经验，一直跑调，尤其高音部分；音响还开得特别大，声音刺耳难受，整个楼都在回响。为什么不喜欢：难听的演唱加过大的音量让整个体验很不舒服，本来想逛一会儿，结果没几分钟就躲进店里避开噪音。回想起来那天只记得音乐有多难听，挺可惜的，因为商场平时是个不错的地方。

Q2What kind of music events do people like today?

I think people today prefer music events that are interactive and visually impressive. For example, concerts and music festivals are very popular, because they combine live performance with a lively atmosphere. Many young people also enjoy events where they can take photos and share them on social media, so lighting and stage design matter a lot. Compared to the past, I'd say people now care almost as much about the experience around the music as the music itself.

现在的人喜欢互动性强、视觉效果好的音乐活动。演唱会和音乐节很受欢迎，因为现场表演加热闹的氛围；很多年轻人还喜欢能拍照发社交媒体的活动，所以灯光和舞台设计很重要。和过去比，人们现在几乎同样看重音乐周边的体验。

Q3Do you think children should receive some musical education?

Yes, I think musical education is valuable for children, even if they don't become musicians. Learning an instrument or singing helps children develop patience and concentration, because it takes regular practice to improve. It also gives them a way to express emotions and relieve stress. Of course, it shouldn't be forced, since children who are pushed too hard may end up hating music. So I'd say a light and enjoyable introduction to music is beneficial for most children.

是的，音乐教育对孩子有价值，即使他们不当音乐家。学乐器或唱歌能培养耐心和专注力，因为需要规律练习才能进步；也给孩子表达情绪、缓解压力的方式。当然不能强迫，逼太紧孩子反而会讨厌音乐。轻松愉快的音乐启蒙对大多数孩子有益。

Q4What are the differences between old and young people's music preferences?

I think the differences are quite obvious. Young people tend to prefer pop music, K-pop and electronic music, which they often discover through social media and streaming platforms. Older people, on the other hand, usually enjoy classic songs and traditional music from their own generation, because those songs carry memories of their youth. Another difference is that young people listen to music more frequently, often while studying or commuting, whereas older people might listen mainly for relaxation.

差异很明显。年轻人喜欢流行乐、K-pop 和电子乐，通常通过社交媒体和流媒体平台发现；老一辈喜欢自己年代的经典老歌和传统音乐，因为这些歌承载着他们年轻时的回忆。另一个区别是年轻人听音乐更频繁，学习或通勤时都听，老人则主要为了放松。

Q5What kind of music events are there in your country?

In my country, there are quite a few kinds of music events. Big concerts by famous singers are very common, and they're usually held in large stadiums or arenas. Music festivals have also become popular in recent years, especially among young people, with multiple bands performing over a day or two. On a smaller scale, there are live performances in bars and cafes, and shopping malls often hold promotional events with singers, like the one I mentioned earlier. So there's really something for every taste.

我国音乐活动种类不少。知名歌手的演唱会很常见，通常在大型体育馆或场馆举行；音乐节近几年也流行起来，尤其受年轻人欢迎，一两天内多支乐队演出；小规模的有酒吧和咖啡馆的现场表演，商场也常办带歌手的促销活动，就像我之前提到的那个。各种口味都有得选。

Q6Why do many people like listening to music while doing sports?

I think music helps people exercise in several ways. First, a fast rhythm can help you keep a steady pace, especially when running or cycling, so you don't slow down without noticing. Music also distracts you from the physical discomfort, which makes the workout feel easier and more enjoyable. On top of that, a good playlist can boost your mood and give you extra energy. So I'd say music and sports go together very naturally for most people.

音乐从几个方面帮助运动。快节奏能帮你保持稳定步频，尤其跑步骑车时，不会不知不觉慢下来；音乐还能分散对身体不适的注意力，让锻炼感觉更轻松愉快；好的歌单还能提升心情、给你额外能量。对大多数人来说音乐和运动很自然地搭配。

Q7What are the differences between listening to music at home and at a live concert?

The differences are mainly about sound quality and atmosphere. At home, you can listen in a comfortable environment with good speakers or headphones, and you can control the volume and choose exactly what you want to hear. At a live concert, the sound is much louder and more powerful, and you experience the music together with hundreds of other people, which creates a strong sense of excitement. However, concerts can be tiring and expensive, and the sound isn't always perfect. So I'd say home listening is for relaxation, while concerts are for the experience.

区别主要在音质和氛围。在家可以在舒适环境里用好音响或耳机听，能控制音量、选自己想听的；现场演唱会声音更响更有冲击力，和几百人一起体验音乐，兴奋感很强。不过演唱会累人又贵，音效也不总是完美。在家听是放松，去现场是为了体验。
